tagline: 理光便携相机，1991 年发布
description: 理光于1991年推出的便携相机。配备38 mm f/4.5 - 80 mm f/6.4 zoom lens, 7 elements in 7 groups。快门速度Programmed, 1 sec. - 1/400 sec.。感光度ISO 64 - 3200 (DX-code system)。5-point multi-beam active autofocus system, 650 focusing steps with Spot-AF facility。

specs.镜头: 38 mm f/4.5 - 80 mm f/6.4 zoom lens, 7 elements in 7 groups
specs.对焦: 5-point multi-beam active autofocus system, 650 focusing steps with Spot-AF facility
specs.闪光灯: G.N. 19 m (ISO 100), Auto / On / Off, Soft Flash, Red-eye reduction
specs.英文简介: The RZ-780 is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1991.
